parameters.name: DisplayNameStartsWith
parameters.description: The display name prefix. A left-match query is used.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address of the account.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: PhoneNumber
parameters.description: The phone number of the account.

parameters.name: PhoneRegion
parameters.description: The phone region code. Example: The region code for the Chinese mainland is 86, without the 00 or + prefix.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The account status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

parameters.name: UserExternalId
parameters.description:
The external ID, which is used to associate external data with IDaaS accounts.

Note: The external ID must be unique within the same source type and source ID.

parameters.name: UserSourceId
parameters.description:
The source ID of the account.

For self-built accounts, the default value is the instance ID. For other types, the value corresponds to the enterprise ID of the respective source. For example, for a DingTalk source, the value corresponds to the corpId of the DingTalk enterprise.

parameters.name: UserSourceType
parameters.description:
The source type of the account. Valid values:
- build\_in: self-built.
- ding\_talk: imported from DingTalk.
- ad: imported from AD.
- ldap: imported from LDAP.
- we\_com: imported from WeCom.

parameters.name: UsernameStartsWith
parameters.description: The username prefix. A left-match query is used.
